4 Star Hotel at a 3 Star price! Excellence throughout!

We thought we were only staying here one night when we arrived in Orlando, planning to find an AirBnB, but we liked it so much we extended for a couple weeks.

Joshua at the front desk was an excellent example of the high caliber staff we interacted with throughout our stay. Always warm and friendly, always going out of their way to make us feel welcome. They seem genuinely happy to be hosting you.

The hotel itself is well appointed, modern and immaculately clean in the common areas and the room. It's pet friendly, which we love, and floors were cleaned properly, which is something we find other hotels miss.

Pool, gym and other amenities were great. No free breakfast, but frankly we preferred the option to buy a higher quality, ala carte' breakfast versus the generally bland, low quality options you get at "free breakfast" in other hotels we have stayed.

Great selection of snacks and well presented.

There's grass for the dogs and you are right in the middle of all the theme parks so access everywhere is quick. Great restaurants, Walmart, all the theme parks... and a great mini-golf course with live alligators (LOL) across the street.

Will definitely stay here again the next time we are in Orlando!

I loved my stay at Home2 Suites by Hilton Orlando Near Universal. This hotel was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. I also loved seeing that it was pet friendly because it made the hotel feel welcoming for everyone, and it definitely made me miss my dogs at home.

The staff here were some of the nicest people I have met so far while staying at hotels. Some seemed a little shy at first, but as soon as you talked to them, they were extremely kind, gentle, and helpful. I even gave positive feedback to a supervisor I met in the elevator because the service really stood out to me.

The breakfast was fantastic. I loved that they had two egg options, egg bites and an egg patty, instead of the typical soggy hotel eggs. These were actually tasty. I also appreciated that you could use real plates and silverware both in the room and at breakfast.

My room was huge, and the kitchenette was so convenient. The bed was clean, the pillows were extra comfortable, and the TV worked well, which is honestly a bigger plus than people realize because not every hotel has nice TVs. The property also had great views and a nice overall layout.

The only thing I would change is removing the carpet in the elevator, because it had a smell from people and pets. Other than that, this was a 5/5 stay for me. Next time I come to Orlando, I will absolutely stay here again.

text.text: This is listed on Google as a 3 star hotel but it's somewhere between a 1 and 2 star hotel at best. Photos are misleading.  When I was dropped off, I immediately wondered if the Uber driver dropped me off at the right place. See attached photo and compare it to the Google images. Guy at the desk was nice and got me checked in. When I got to my room, I immediately noticed a pungent and unpleasant chemical cleaning smell that was almost starting to give me a headache. The room was also grimy and not well cleaned. I couldn't even stay in the room long enough to research alternative arrangements on my phone so I hung out by the pool area to look on my phone. About 30 minutes after checking in, I told them I needed to check out and declined a different room because of the strong cleaning chemical smell in the first room. I stood there and argued for 5-10 minutes with the 2 desk people and some random guy that seemed to know them because the hotel refused to refund the $75 I paid for the room. This is all in the midst of Storm Fern while I'm trying to get back home from a trip but stranded in Orlando indefinitely until flights get figured out and I already don't know if I'm getting comped for other additional expenses. So now I have to worry about $75 for a hotel room they I didn't use and would have had no way of knowing I would have needed to cancel until I walked into the actual room. Don't forget to look at the photo I included and ask yourself if it looks like it matches up with the photos they put online. Once again this is a 2 star hotel AT BEST.

The design of the room was good. We appreciated the extra sink outside of the bathroom for getting four people ready in the mornings. The bathroom has a sliding door that wouldn’t stay closed. The water for the shower would only get to warm, never hot, even though we requested it be checked. We were going to Disney and it was rainy, so a hot shower would’ve been nice. We were there four nights and our room was cleaned once, with no extra toilet paper left and the shampoo and conditioner bottles were left empty, as well as two dirty towels left in the bathroom. When we called the desk, we were told we could come down and get the items, but no one could bring them to us.

There’s a free breakfast with eggs, sausage or bacon and the general bread items. Both my daughter and I have a gluten allergy and we asked if there was anything gluten free, since there’s a sign in the breakfast area saying to ask if you have an allergy. The lady working the breakfast just looked at me and said, “no, we don’t have anything.” The first couple of mornings we just ate the eggs and sausage and fruit, but one morning there wasn’t fruit left and it didn’t get replenished. The potatoes made us both sick (the seasoning I think), so breakfast was a challenge, compared to other hotels we’ve been at recently.
Overall, it was a decent place to stay, but not likely one we will return to (we’re in Orlando often).

text.text:
Date of stay - June 2026

2 Adults and 1 child

Great hotel, clean, rooms made up every single day and towels changed daily also.

Service second to none.

The hotel has a policy of quiet hours after 10pm which was good too know as sound can travel from adjoining rooms and at one point I thought I might of needed to engage with the staff to intervene which they strictly enforce, but thankfully, the overly loud room next door left.

Not sure why the cheap toilet paper as we just ended up using twice as much, small thing really.

The pool is very shallow, never getting any deeper than roughly 3ft, so swimming is difficult, but as relief from the hot humid environment is 1st class. Brace yourself for a hefty bar bill if drinking at the pool or the bar in there hotel, very much in keeping with big city prices.

The cafe is good for some things such as pizza, but for a good breakfast IHop is a five minute walk away which is almost impossible to finish for less money, the breakfast in the hotel is meger at best.

The free shuttle buses to the parks are great, Andy the early access to the parks is worth it's weight in gold.

Getting around - if you're staying local, Ubers are cheap, efficient, friendly and plentiful. If you're planning get out further afield, hire a car for those days, but for us, there was no point as we had free shuttle buses.

Eating out from this location - we found Icon Park a really good option which is a 5 dollar Uber away where there are a good range of restaurants for all tastes.

All in all though, 4.5 stars from me, would definitely stay here again.

I would like to provide feedback regarding my recent stay.

First, I was supposed to be notified when my room was ready, but I never received a call or text. Because I was waiting for that notification, I stayed longer at the park and became extremely exhausted while waiting to check in. I finally called around 6:00 PM and was told my room had been ready, but there were system issues. If the system was having problems, someone could have called me to let me know instead of leaving me waiting without any communication.

Second, I requested a late checkout, but it appears that information was not properly communicated to housekeeping. A housekeeper came to my door shortly after 9:00 AM even though the normal checkout time was 11:00 AM and I had been approved for a late checkout. Later, I called the front desk and requested a luggage cart be sent up when I was preparing to leave. Instead, a housekeeper arrived with a different piece of equipment, and when I explained that I had requested a luggage cart, another employee told me I would have to go downstairs and get it myself, despite the front desk advising that one would be sent to my room.

To make matters worse, another housekeeper knocked on my door around 11:20 AM while I was having a conversation with my daughter. Since I had been approved for a 12:00 PM checkout, it was very frustrating and disruptive to have multiple interruptions. There seemed to be a significant lack of communication between the front desk and housekeeping staff, which negatively impacted my privacy and peace during my stay.

Finally, the café staff gave me a difficult time when I attempted to use my dining voucher for juice. We spent approximately 30 minutes discussing something that should have been simple to resolve, which was both frustrating and unnecessary.

Overall, the recurring communication issues between departments created an unpleasant experience and significantly affected the quality of my stay. I hope these concerns are addressed so future guests do not encounter the same problems. I would not be back to this hotel at all

It's the best price for having a suite. The hotel is clean and all of the staff is very friendly and helpful. We arrived at noon and our room was ready, plus they gave us a one hour later checkout. Absolutely do NOT get a "Studio Deluxe." It is tiny, dingy, dark, and features a very heavy Murphy bed you have to pull down. And in order to pull it down, you have to disassemble the couch below it. Extremely inconvenient, plus the Murphy bed in our room was saggy and I was rolling into my spouse all night, leading to poor sleep and back pain. Furthermore, after paying for a second room to "upgrade" for a portion of our trip, neither room felt cleaned. The more expensive (but much better layout and experience) "1 Bedroom Deluxe" still had several hairs all over the shower from the previous occupants. The "Studio Deluxe" was so appalling, the housekeeper who came to help us sweep on the second day in the room stated it was in a "terrible state" and "had never seen anything like that before". There were few amenities on-site accept for a pool, jacuzzi, and gym, despite being a "vacation resort."

Side note: the jacuzzi was fun and informative as it was a 2 hour session of Worldmark Timeshare Owners and individuals staying through RCI complaining and warning everyone AGAINST signing up for the Timeshare/becoming an Owner, with a few people even having enlisted attorneys to get themselves out of their bait-and-switch memberships. Of which the whole reason we stayed was because we were lied to and bait-and-switched into a temporary version of their Timeshare called the "Discovery Program", which during our sales presentation (yes you had to go to one of those, AGAIN) the salespeople AGREED it was all a lie and bait-and-switch, and claimed Worldmark is redoing their training programs because it was a rampant problem.
We also had on and off AC issues the whole trip with it vacillating between hot and HUMID and ice cold, with the thermostat locked up behind a locked door and maintenance had to come adjust it themselves anytime we needed a change.

The saving grace was the kindness and attentiveness of the staff. However, this was still the worst hotel experience in recent memory.

text.text:
We absolutely loved our stay here all around with so many positive aspects.  For context, we've also stayed at Marriott Harbour Lake and Marriott Grande Vista. Our whole family agreed we loved Cypress Harbour the most and would return here.

A highlight of our stay was DJ Sarah Masters at the pool. Not only did she play great music, but she had such fun games for the kids and kept them entertained and really had great presence!

The main pool by the lobby was lovely. There was a section in it with jacuzzi jets which was really neat as well as a volleyball net and a couple of hot tubs.

We stayed in building 66 and loved the pool near us as well. It had a sauna and a waterfall into the pool which was fun for the kids.

The service here was phenomenal. It was so convenient to text or use the MVC app to request pool towels exchanges and they were rather quick. We love MVCs because of the spacious suites with full kitchens and laundry. So convenient. We even were able to request a blender to make smoothies. Sleeping arrangements and space was great. Although I do like how harbour lake and Grande Vista had two double beds in the second bedroom. This one had a double + sofa bed which was a bit more cramped. The sofa bed was decent though and you could ask for a mattress topper (but we didn't). The huge jacuzzi in the large bedroom was really nice!

The activities club staff were all really great and the kids loved receiving tokens for participation which they then exchanged for prizes which was memorable. We enjoyed learning shuffleboard and the activities staff even took the time to help the kids learn and they were so patient. The activities schedule is quite fun. We loved family puzzle races and just going into the activity centre to see the baby gators or do a puzzle, colour, morning crafts (free of charge (etc). There were playgrounds and mini golf, pool tables, arcade (for a cost) available as well. So much to do that I probably didn't even list.

There is security entrance which made it feel safer.

Loved the boat taxi as well to get from activities to lobby pool area.

The gym was well equipped and the water filter fountain in the gym was fabulous.

Check-in was smooth and easy and the front desk staff were really friendly and efficient.

For the most part we bought groceries and cooked for the week. We did order some kids meals the last day which were pretty standard (burgers, chicken tenders).

Great and convenient location to sea world, groceries and more.

We hope to see you all again! Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Our stay at Conrad Orlando was genuinely exceptional from start to finish. After a long Disney trip, this hotel felt calm, luxurious, and incredibly well-run.

The property itself is stunning, with beautiful modern design, a relaxing atmosphere, and amazing views. Our room overlooked EPCOT, and being able to see the area from our room made the stay feel extra special. The rooms were absolutely spotless and felt fresh, polished, and thoughtfully maintained.

One of the biggest highlights of the stay was the lagoon area. It was beautiful, peaceful, and incredibly relaxing — truly one of our favorite parts of the entire experience. It gave the resort such a calm luxury feel while still being fun and welcoming.

What stood out most, though, was the level of service. Every interaction we had with staff felt warm, professional, and attentive without being overbearing. The resort managed to feel upscale while still being comfortable and inviting.

We were especially impressed with how peaceful and refined the overall experience felt compared to many busy Orlando resorts. It truly felt like a luxury escape while still being close to Disney.

This was one of the most memorable hotel stays we’ve had in a long time, and we would absolutely return.

We have stayed at Conrad hotels before and they have never let us down.

I really enjoyed my stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites Orlando International Drive North. It’s a great value if you want to be close to everything without paying resort prices. You’re only a couple of miles from Universal and within walking distance of ICON Park, which made getting around super easy.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and had a microwave and mini-fridge, which I appreciated. Free parking and a hot breakfast (especially the waffle station) were nice bonuses, and not having a resort fee was a big plus.

The only downside was a bit of highway noise and a busy breakfast area in the morning, but overall, it’s a comfortable, convenient stay that I’d definitely recommend.
